messages:
maya-s: heads up — Solaris (dedicated slice) scheduled for 03/27 04:00 UTC. need confirmation on: model pin, kv-cache priming, and pre-warm pool sizing. can we lock a plan?
deploybot: automated checklist attached: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m/60m/120m, health probes: 200 OK + p95 latency < 400ms, error-rate < 0.5%. rollback action: traffic -> previous model variant.
jun-lee: kv-cache priming script ready. will run prefix-warm with 10k tokens across 4 workers. note: script hits grpc endpoints with --concurrency 8.
ops_lead_rachel: window request from customer: can we shift to 02:00 UTC instead? their QA team wants early morning in CET. shifting affects oncall rotations — need ack from SRE.
nia-sre: 02:00 UTC ok for SRE but we need additional 30m canary extension. propose canary 5% for 45m, 25% for 90m. add alert if gpu_util > 92% for 3m or if OOMs > 0 across any pod.
paul-eng: model variant to pin: redwood/gglm-quant-v1.2.3-q4_0. Pin request submitted to model-catalog. This variant has a slightly higher latency but 2.1x lower GPU memory. pack size for dedicated pool set to 8.
maya-s: confirm quantized pin accepted? any compatibility issues with KV cache offsets?
paul-eng: compatibility verified. minor KV offset handling changed in runtime 2.8.1 — we've included conversion in the priming script. snippet: 
```
# priming (abridged)
python tools/kv_priming.py --model redwood/gglm-quant-v1.2.3-q4_0 --tokens 10000 --concurrency 8
```
deploybot: deploy plan updated: window 02:00 UTC, canary schedule per SRE suggestion, pre-warm step inserted before canary start. pre-warm runs at T-10m.
security-bot: KMS rotation scheduled for 02:30 UTC in customer tenant window. collision risk: if KMS rotates mid-canary keys may re-fetch. recommend postponing rotation to 04:00 UTC or move deployment earlier than rotation.
maya-s: customer ops confirmed they can postpone KMS rotation to 04:00 UTC. they asked for an extra rollback SLA: automatic rollback if 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained for 10m.
nia-sre: auto-rollback trigger ok. adding extra metric: prompt-drop rate > 0.3% for 5m triggers immediate traffic cut.
jun-lee: priming dry-run completed in staging, memory usage looked fine. will run small-scale warm at T-30 to validate offsets.
ops_lead_rachel: two operational asks: (1) oncall lead: @nia-sre will be primary, @paul-eng backup; (2) staging release notes pasted to customer slack channel after pre-warm success.
paul-eng: rollforward plan documented. codehash: 7e4a2fd. model catalog entry: /models/redwood/gglm-quant-v1.2.3-q4_0@20260319.
maya-s: OK — locking window 02:00 UTC, canary extension + priming as discussed. rachel please confirm your ops checklist and close this thread when done.
ops_lead_rachel: ops checklist acked. I'll post a final readiness message 30m before window.
deploybot: scheduled: 3805012345 -> window 02:00 UTC. pre-warm T-10m, canary 5% 45m, 25% 90m, full 120m. alerts: p95>400ms, gpu_util>92% 3m, OOM>0, 5xx>0.8% 10m, prompt-drop>0.3% 5m. auto-rollback: enabled.
maya-s: thanks team — go/no-go will be in this thread at T-15.
nia-sre: marking primary oncall. will post live metrics link when canary starts.
paul-eng: prepping rollback artifact and previous model variant tag: redwood/gglm-stable-v1.2.2.
security-bot: noted KMS rotation move to 04:00 UTC. no remaining conflicts.
maya-s: GO from maya-s at 01:45 UTC — pre-warm starting in 15m. :rocket:
